sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: A vast, community-driven ecosystem of design assets, templates, and AI-powered tools directly integrated within the Figma design and collaboration platform, fostering innovation and resource sharing.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Figma Community is a platform within Figma where users can discover, share, and utilize community-made design resources including UI kits, wireframes, templates, assets, AI workflows, plugins, extensions, and templates for whiteboarding and presentations.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Design resources (UI kits
wireframes
templates
assets)
AI workflows
Extensions (plugins
generative plugins
Weave tools
AI skills)
Whiteboarding templates (brainstorming
team meetings
diagramming)
and Presentation templates.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Free (for accessing and many community resources); content creators may offer premium resources.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Designers, developers, product managers, marketing professionals, educators, and teams seeking to enhance design workflows, collaboration, and productivity.
